resources.string: Your local data stays on this device. Only verified database results can continue startup.
Checking the encrypted local database. This may finish without another prompt.
Applying the confirmed database update. Keep the app open.
The local database could not be opened with the available key. Enter a key you know is correct.
The saved user-provided key cannot be read on this device. You can enter the known key without replacing it.
The device-generated database key cannot be recovered. Manual key entry is not offered because this key was never shown.
This app version needs to update the local database before it can open.
Opening with this version requires a downgrade and has %1$d applicable warning(s). Continue only with a disposable or verified backup.
This app cannot safely change the current database version. No in-app recovery is claimed.
A local database operation failed. Technical payloads are hidden from this screen.
Android secure storage is not available for this database operation.
The database operation stopped without changing the confirmed migration choice.
The database returned an unsupported result. No raw diagnostic data is displayed.
Both matching pre-encryption files were copied. The database has not been opened yet.
Matching local pair was not copied
The bounded local copy did not complete. The database result has not changed.
The passphrase is not saved unless you choose “Save and open.”
This bounded recovery replaces only the exact timestamp-matched chat and agent database pair. Copying does not prove the database can open.
Both current local database files will be replaced by their exact matching pre-encryption copies. Opening remains a separate step.
